name: LLM quotas
author: ziouf
description: Enriches the built-in Agents panel with LLM quota tabs: OpenCode Go's rolling 5-hour, weekly, and monthly windows (official OpenCode Zen usage API) plus OpenRouter key credits and monthly spend (official key API). No widget, no UI of its own — the stock panel picks tabs up automatically.

install.notes: `omarchy plugin add https://github.com/ziouf/omarchy-opencode-go-quotas.git --enable`, then make sure the service is listed in shell.json: { "plugins": [ { "id": "ziouf.llm-quotas" } ] }. Tabs appear in your existing Agents panel as soon as a credential is resolved — nothing else to configure, and the panel itself is never modified or duplicated.

optional: rm -f "$HOME/.config/omarchy/api-keys.env"  # only if nothing else uses it
uninstall.notes: Removing the service stops the refreshes and unloads the tabs from the Agents panel on the next rescan. The commands above are documentation; run them manually for a spotless cleanup.
